targets.note: Onboarding, Connect your AI: Sign in with Claude, Sign in with ChatGPT and Sign in with Grok, and the API key as the alternative. Pressing one starts the provider's own sign-in on the server.
After Sign in with Claude: Open the sign-in (opens the browser), Copy link, and the field for the code Claude's page shows.
After Sign in with ChatGPT: the code to type on OpenAI's device page, Open the sign-in, and the line that this page finishes by itself.
Settings, AI accounts, Add Claude: the same link-and-code panel in the Vault's Add an AI provider sheet.
Settings, AI accounts, Add ChatGPT: the code to type, and it finishes by itself.
